{{NPC infobox}}
'''Keeper''' is the [[character]] controlled by the player in ''[[Graveyard Keeper 2]]''. As the playable character, the Keeper does not have any associated [[quests]] or {{Icon|Reputation}} reputation.

The Keeper's appearance can be changed using the [[Dresser with Mirror]] in the [[Home]]. Most appearances are obtained as quest rewards.
